claims.claim: The DP Compact Portable Rechargeable LED Torch Light is suitable for homes, security personnel,...
claims.evidence: Witness only reports a black cylindrical tactical-style flashlight/torch; no readable branding/model or specs.

claims.claim: Like new, never repaired or opened
claims.evidence: No proof of repair/opening status in the shown images; only external appearance is partially visible.
No receipt/warranty documents are shown in the witness report.
Witness did not show the torch turned on, beam output, or any functional test.

risks.risk: It may not work or may have weak output (battery dead, faulty driver, or damaged LED).
risks.proof: A short video clip showing the torch switched on from off to high/low (and any strobe if present), with the beam visible in a dark area.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a non-tested/possibly faulty rechargeable torch.

risks.risk: Rechargeable battery condition may be poor (won’t hold charge or charges slowly).
risks.proof: A clip showing charging in progress (indicator light if any) and then a runtime test (e.g., continuous operation for a short fixed interval).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as needing replacement batteries or with reduced runtime.

risks.proof: A photo/video showing everything included laid out (charger, cable, manual, holster/lanyard if any).

risks.risk: Lens/reflector may be scratched, cracked, or fogged, reducing brightness and beam quality.
risks.proof: Close-up shots of the front lens and reflector area from multiple angles under light, showing any scratches/cracks.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as having unknown lens condition.

risks.risk: Unclear exact model/specs (lumens/wattage, beam distance, water resistance), which affects value.
risks.proof: A clear photo of any label/sticker with model number and specs (lumens/wattage, IP rating) or the box/manual.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic tactical LED torch with unknown output and rating.

proof_requests: Show the torch turned on (high/low and any strobe) in a dark environment; record a short beam video.
Show charging: plug it in, show indicator behavior (if any), then demonstrate it running after charging.
Provide clear photos of any model/brand label and the exact specs (lumens/wattage, runtime, IP rating).
Show what’s included: charger/cable, batteries (if separate), holster/lanyard, receipt/warranty documents.
response.reason: The witness can identify it as a black tactical-style rechargeable LED torch, but functional performance and key accessories/specs are not shown. It can still be priced at its worst case as a non-tested rechargeable torch until proof of working condition and included items is provided.
